requirements.text: The guards in scripts/kit.py are proven by tests, so the product is not trusted on faith
OpenCode users get the same tool-call blocking as Claude Code and Cursor users
Every pull request shows the kit's evidence result, so teams see proof without opening a terminal
Codex users install the guard hook with one command instead of manual steps
A feature is finished with one command, and the command never passes a criterion without a named passing test
The agent never changes protected files, admin switches or pushes as part of finishing a feature
A new project gets its test command set up at init, so no manual step is needed before the first feature

features.title: Test suite for the guards in scripts/kit.py

acceptance.check: A test creates a scratch git repo, runs kit.py init, and kit.py check exits 0
acceptance.evidence: python3 -m unittest discover -v -s tests: named test passed (test_AC_001_0x); verify.sh full PASS (2026-11-05)

acceptance.check: Editing scripts/kit.py in a scratch repo makes kit.py check exit non-zero with 'protected guard file changed'
acceptance.evidence: python3 -m unittest discover -v -s tests: named test passed (test_AC_001_0x); verify.sh full PASS (2026-11-05)

acceptance.check: kit.py done fails when any acceptance criterion of the feature has no PASS evidence
acceptance.evidence: python3 -m unittest discover -v -s tests: named test passed (test_AC_001_0x); verify.sh full PASS (2026-11-05)

acceptance.check: Deleting or skipping an existing test (for example adding .skip) is reported by kit.py check
acceptance.evidence: python3 -m unittest discover -v -s tests: named test passed (test_AC_001_0x); verify.sh full PASS (2026-11-05)

acceptance.check: dep-check or check reports a new package that has no entry in docs/dependencies.md
acceptance.evidence: python3 -m unittest discover -v -s tests: named test passed (test_AC_001_0x); verify.sh full PASS (2026-11-05)

features.notes: New test files only, under tests/. Do not edit scripts/kit.py to make tests pass. If a test exposes a real bug, record it in agent/known-issues.md and ask the human for GUARD_ADMIN=1.

features.title: OpenCode guard plugin

acceptance.check: An OpenCode plugin file in .opencode/plugins/ loads without error in OpenCode
The plugin's tool.execute.before hook throws when the tool call edits a protected guard file
The plugin lets ordinary edits through without throwing

features.notes: Guard files are human-only: a human must set GUARD_ADMIN=1 to commit the plugin. Verify the exact tool.execute.before signature in https://opencode.ai/docs/plugins/ first and record it in docs/decisions.md. Hook behaviour is verified only by running OpenCode, not by reading the docs.

features.title: Pull request comment with the kit's evidence result

acceptance.check: On a pull request, the CI workflow posts one comment with the verify summary (PASS, FAIL or SKIP per gate)
When the kit check fails, the workflow fails and the comment names the failing gate
The comment step runs only with pull-requests: write permission and never prints secrets

features.notes: .github/workflows/verify.yml is a CI file and may be protected: treat changes as human-approved. Update the comment in place on re-runs instead of posting a new one each time.

features.title: One-command Codex guard hook installer

acceptance.check: kit.py hooks --install writes ~/.codex/config.toml and ~/.codex/hooks.json with the guard entry
Running the installer twice does not duplicate the hook entry
An existing ~/.codex/hooks.json with other hooks is merged, not overwritten

features.notes: Writes to the user's home folder. Show the diff and ask before writing. kit.py is protected: a human sets GUARD_ADMIN=1 to commit the change.

features.title: kit.py finish FEAT-x: one command that runs the gate, passes proven criteria, marks done, writes progress

acceptance.check: In a scratch repo with a feature whose criteria all have named passing tests, kit.py finish FEAT-x exits 0, marks every criterion pass and the feature done, and appends a progress entry naming the gate result
A criterion whose ID appears in no passing test is not marked pass; finish exits non-zero and lists that criterion under NEEDS YOU
A criterion whose named test fails is not marked pass, even when other criteria pass
finish refuses to run when a protected file has uncommitted changes, and prints the exact files the human must commit
finish never sets GUARD_ADMIN, SPEC_CHANGE_APPROVED or KIT_ALLOW_* and never runs git push
finish refuses when agent/last-verify.log is older than the newest source file, and runs the gate first when asked with --gate
finish with any manual criterion (no test ID) stops before marking done and asks the human for evidence

features.notes: kit.py is protected: the human commits it with the admin switch. Output is one screen: what passed, what needs the human, the one next command. Do not weaken the existing pass rule: pass by hand keeps working for manual criteria.

features.title: Test command set up automatically at init, with verbose names for traceability

acceptance.check: kit.py init in a Python project writes VERIFY_TEST with a verbose runner so test names appear in the log
kit.py init in a Node project writes VERIFY_TEST as npm test
When no stack is detected, init prints the one line the human must add and does not guess

features.notes: Touches kit.py and verify.config (protected): the human commits both. Detection uses only files that exist (pyproject.toml, package.json, go.mod, Cargo.toml).
